text: {"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["y tulacal bahũ baal (and all things [were created])"], "added": ["of a well"], "mistranslated": ["heklae Chen y à pacticabae ca yuchul (that happens only when you look at yourselves) -> although you see yourself in it, it does not truly come into being", "t yinhi (existed) -> was born", "tan â culpachticeex hahal Dioz (turning your backs on the true God) -> that you take for the true God", "topzazil (supremely clear / radiant) -> the beginning", "hele û chichnile (now the younger one) -> One of them was very diligent", "hach chacan tech (very clear / manifest to you) -> very like you"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["c tucliceex (that we think / which we think)"], "added": ["and it stops moving as well"], "mistranslated": ["hebal c tucliceex â hanonexe (what we think when eating) -> that come when we sleep"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is far superior and accurate, correctly translating theological vocabulary and idioms such as culpachticeex ('turn your backs on') and topzazil ('supremely clear') where Translation A introduces several serious mistranslations."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ti alakoob ('by dependents/creatures') -> 'by the women'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["kahez ('remember')", "u tħibete", "â nahalticoob ('earning/meriting them')"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["h ma cux olé ('senseless/foolish one') -> 'hard-hearted one'", "ca tu chok cħintah tu yich ('dashed/flung it against his face') -> 'sprinkled it on his face'", "pahzubtal ('shame/ignominy') -> 'condemnation'", "u chucanob ('the rest/others') -> 'sinners'", "lay à lolob la kilob ('those evil companions/false friends') -> 'those flowers and pleasures'", "ɔocan à manzic u yanalob àzab nohob ('after enduring it, other greater things [will come]') -> 'you have had enough of other things already'", "à culpachticoob ('to renounce them') -> 'as you confess them'", "alabolal ('faith/confidence') -> 'great joy'", "caxi hach pachalace ('even though it is very late') -> 'Quickly'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is complete and highly faithful to the Yucatec Maya source, whereas Translation B contains severe mistranslations, including rendering bad companions as 'flowers and pleasures', faith as 'great joy', and very late as 'quickly'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["û pectzil (the rumor/news of his conduct)", "ꝑel (only / only-begotten in 'ù ꝑel mehen')"], "added": ["\"No wonder I look like him\""], "mistranslated": ["bai tun Xitħic û pectzil û lobil û beel (thus the rumor of his wicked conduct spread abroad) -> and so his evil ways grew worse", "maix tan û Kantal û yatal tauol (nor will your heart fail to feel grief/regret) -> and you will find no time in your heart", "ma hakotzil ca chacanacentii (do not be afraid that I appear to you) -> No wonder I look like him", "y ù hach yatal tin Uol ù Zatal Uinicoob (and because the loss of mankind so deeply grieves my heart) -> and had great love in my heart for lost mankind"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is complete and exceptionally accurate throughout, whereas Translation B commits several serious mistranslations of key Maya idioms and dialogue, most egregiously rendering 'do not be afraid that I appear to you' as 'No wonder I look like him'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["tancab (courtyard / outside)"], "added": ["was greatly angered at this"], "mistranslated": ["In heláancuntah bahun leytiá Ahzáat-zahuléex (how our Savior changed this) -> Our offended Savior was greatly angered at this", "Bay ti hun hatzul (in like manner / in one part) -> With a single stroke", "tulacal xakáan (all mixed together / thrown into confusion) -> all spilled out", "Ahzáat-zah zipiléex (our Forgiver of sins) -> our offended Savior", "ti c nuculil cuxtaléex (to the conduct of our lives) -> to the thoughts of our lives", "uaiix tá kaholticéex (or what you know/recognize) -> or through ignorance", "ti hach nohochil hatzul ti le kulnaéex (in the greater part of your churches) -> as very great offenses in the temple", "cú talel (there comes / arises) -> you come"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is exceptionally accurate and captures the Maya syntax and vocabulary faithfully, whereas Translation B makes numerous serious errors, including mistranslating 'hatzul' (parts) as strokes and offenses, and rendering 'what you recognize' as 'ignorance'."}
